title: Volley Screen Channel Message
description: Retained tail of an agent's terminal, published by a supervisor on the agent's behalf to volley/<ns>/<agent_id>/screen and cleared with an empty retained payload when the agent is retired. The envelope agent_id is the publisher (the supervisor); the topic segment names the agent. See spec section 4.6.6.

hash.description: Content hash of lines; publishers skip unchanged captures.

source.description: Capture mechanism; cmux in the reference implementation.
